about_the_game:
Survive waves of enemies, acquire new weapons, take down bosses. Temporalysis is a 2D action rogue-like shooter where you can slow time to compensate for the chaos.

Select one of 12 primary weapons each with their own benefits and burdens, a defensive weapon like Spread might keep the enemies away, but the Nebulizer would kill them faster.

Augment your attacks with one of 12 secondary weapons. Mesh your primary and secondary weapons to compliment each other. Use the Portal to accelerate your Blade attacks, or use Blast to keep the enemies at bay while you mow them down with Accelerant.

There are 17 different enemy types, and different weapons will work better against some than others. Preview the wave contents and select your weapons carefully!

The enemies move quickly and it can quickly become hectic. Slow down time for a short period to make a calculated escape or to aim your attacks more accurately.

Abilities are rare but powerful upgrades that provide passive bonuses. From pushing your attackers away to increasing your damage, they can provide a flurry of beneficial effects.

name: Temporalysis
short_description: A quick paced 2D rogue-like shooter. Shoot your way through endless waves of enemies, acquire new abilities and new weapons as you take on more difficult foes. Your adversaries are moving too fast? Slow down time to aim better or make a quick escape.
